title: Tension in rope OD
description: Essential: Correctly calculates F_OD = m_B g / cos37° = 40 N.

title: Tension in rope OE
description: Essential: Correctly calculates F_OE = m_B g tan37° = 24 N.

title: Friction on block A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates f_A = F_OD - m_A g sin37° = 9.6 N and states direction down incline.

title: Force balance at knot
description: Important: Applies equilibrium at point O/D to relate tensions and weight of B.

title: Force balance on block A
description: Important: Analyzes forces parallel to incline (tension, gravity component, friction) for equilibrium.

title: System horizontal equilibrium
description: Important: Considers horizontal forces on combined system (A+C+pulley) to find ground friction.

title: Ground friction magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly concludes f_ground = F_OE = 24 N from horizontal equilibrium.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Misassigns direction of friction on A or sign in incline force balance.

title: Component mistakes
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong trig functions (sin/cos) for tension or gravity components.

title: Isolation errors
description: Pitfall: Fails to properly isolate subsystems (knot, block A, whole system) for equilibrium.
